description: The final SPECIAL EDITION selection concentrates on the Vulcan reformation, the Babel crisis and the birth of interstellar cooperation that points directly toward the Federation.

s04e01.description: A bombing at Earth's Vulcan embassy sends Archer and T'Pol into the desert searching for the Syrrannites and the truth behind the attack.

s04e02.description: Archer becomes entangled with the legacy of Surak while Vulcan political forces move against the Syrrannites and prepare for war.

s04e03.description: Enterprise races to stop a Vulcan-Andorian war as Archer carries an ancient artifact capable of overturning Vulcan society.

s04e04.description: Enterprise escorts Tellarites to peace talks with Andoria while a mysterious ship attacks both sides and impersonates its victims.

s04e05.description: Archer struggles to unite Andorians, Tellarites and Vulcans against the Romulan drone ships while Shran demands a deadly personal settlement.

s04e06.description: The search for the telepath controlling the Romulan drones leads Enterprise to the reclusive Aenar beneath Andoria's frozen surface.

s04e07.description: Years later, Enterprise approaches the founding of the Federation as Archer prepares for a defining speech and the crew faces one final crisis.
